definitions.explanation: From English "chest." In Japanese it means a piece of storage furniture — most often a chest of drawers for clothes, sometimes a lidded box. It is not used for the human chest, which is {胸|むね}.

examples.japanese: チェスト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しまう。
examples.english: I put my clothes away in the chest of drawers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝室|しんしつ}→寝室：05300_shinshitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧チェスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put a wooden chest of drawers in the bedroom.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧チェスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to get rid of the old chest of drawers when I moved and rethink my storage.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧チェスト: clothing chest
- ローチェスト: low chest, a waist-height chest of drawers
- ⟦ツール→ツール：11044_tsuuru⟧チェスト: tool chest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- たんす: traditional Japanese chest of drawers — the older, more common word
- ⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧: storage case — usually plastic boxes rather than furniture

WATCH OUT:
Do not use チェスト for the part of the body. The chest of a person is ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧; チェスト in a fitness or clothing-size context refers to the chest measurement, not the body part itself.
